A concise collection of lessons and fabrication tools lets you choose a module to start or continue your work. The path begins with Culture and Land-Based Learning, then moves through the S.O. N.I.C.E. Design Process, logo design, accessible communication, laser cutting and fabrication, CAD and parametric modelling, phone-holder design and construction, and advanced making.
